findings.summary: The fallback branch (src/input.rs:284-288) that keeps first-line binary detection for short first reads has no test; deleting it would silently regress.
The boundary half of the new unit test pins a NUL at byte 1025 as UTF_8, which encodes content_inspector's limit and could break on a correct improvement.
The fallback comment names custom BufRead as the trigger when bat's own stdin lock on a pipe is the common case.
The PR body omits that piped input only sees the first read(); suggest one sentence under Compatibility.
Lean: replace the clear/extend_from_slice copy with a slice pick, saving about 2 lines.

why: The only Important finding was confirmed but is a coverage gap for a correct, working branch; a busy maintainer would merge without it (as they did), so it is graded a nit and no blocking findings remain.
